title: The calendar is a gate
governingQuestion: How does a public timetable distribute private permission?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Tokyo makes translation infrastructural across permission, venue, moving image, language, textile exchange, recognition and retained seasons. This chapter follows access: The decisive technology is not the door but the stack of schedule, accreditation, invitation and identity checks that precedes it.
beats.onScreen: Then: JFWO was established in 2005 and positions Fashion Week beside textile and related industry divisions.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: JFWO was established in 2005 and positions Fashion Week beside textile and related industry divisions. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The current official schedule labels entries by runway, presentation, showroom or event and exposes open-to-public versus invitation-only states.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The public pages do not expose one universal invitation, security, seating or accessibility stack across every participating venue.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
